2.16.24
Textbox.ToggleImage
The Textbox.ToggleImage element specifies the initial state (+/-) of a toggle image if one is
displayed as part of a Textbox. This element is optional and of type ToggleImage.
Following is the parent element of the Textbox.ToggleImage element.
Parent elements
Textbox
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Textbox.ToggleImage element.
 <xsd:element name="ToggleImage" type="ToggleImageType" minOccurs="0" />
